The main execution flow: first checks if getActivity() is not null, then creates a Snackbar with an action listener. The action listener (lambda) is executed later when the user clicks, not in the current call stack. Potential runtime exceptions: (1) NullPointerException if binding.emptyListView is null (in Snackbar.make calls) or if getResources() returns null; (2) ClassCastException in the lambda if getActivity() returns an object not of type PreviewImageActivity.
